runnerPolicy.note: Runner facts are recorded in artifact evidence; the protocol does not require self-hosted runners.

versionImpact.rationale: The v1.0 production release establishes the current KFD content and registry schema surfaces with number-stable decision paths.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: KFD documents are append-only content coordinates; current decision text changes do not alter a machine-consumed surface.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.
The npm package continues to publish README.md, decisions/, registry.json, site/, and docs/; decision filenames use the stable kfd-N.md convention before production promotion.

recovery.rollback: Use the previous exact release tag or previous floating channel ref.
